_comments: APOLLO as an MJ: Integrations row, so a company can hold its own Apollo key on an MJ: Company
Integrations row linked to an MJ: Credentials record of type API Key ({ "apiKey": "…" }).
@memberjunction/actions-apollo already resolves keys by this Integration's Name (lists/credentials.ts,
APOLLO_INTEGRATION_NAME); until this row existed the per-company path could never match, and every
action fell back to the APOLLO_API_KEY environment variable. ClassName is null on purpose: this is a
vendor API, not a sync connector, so the Integration engine has nothing to run for it
(MJCompanyIntegrationEntityServer logs 'No connector registered' and skips its pipeline).
BatchMaxRequestCount 10 is Apollo's people/bulk_match ceiling. No sync block: the release push writes

fields.Name: Apollo
fields.Description: Apollo.io (apollo.io): person and organization enrichment (people/bulk_match, organizations/enrich), prospecting search, and list management. Used by the Apollo Enrichment and Apollo list actions and by the person-enrichment engine in BizApps Common.
